description: Mutes a conversation until snoozed_until (ISO 8601, in the future), at most 10 minutes from now (a later time is cut to 10 minutes), as the inbox's Mute does while someone is on a call. note is optional. For a later follow-up, use set_conversation_reminder. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: snooze_conversation
title: Mute a conversation for a few minutes
